display_name: Interpretation Act 1987 (NSW): whole Act, with a seat layer for a person holding a time limit
encoder: a single Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone from this brief
seat: A person who has a time limit to meet under a New South Wales Act or statutory rule (to apply, object, appeal, reply or pay), or who needs to know when something takes effect, asking on which day their period ends and which of their days count.
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text, and nothing in it has been checked against the official text of the Act. The tests were written by the same agent that wrote the rules. The text encoded is an unofficial plain-text rendering.

scope.text: Interpretation Act 1987 No 15 (NSW), the whole text of act-1987-015.txt: Parts 1 to 11 and 6A, Schedules 1 to 4, with every Part, section, subsection, paragraph, Schedule clause, Dictionary term and Schedule table row in the coverage table of NOTES.md.
scope.edition: the version dated 2024-11-21 (nsw_legislation:2024-11-21/act-1987-015) from the Open Australian Legal Corpus 7.1.0, collected on 2025-03-10; an unofficial rendering
scope.encoded: all operative provisions, as rules with tests and a source citation on each; the Dictionary as a table and as functions; the time rules in one self-contained module; the cross-references and an index of provisions as data
scope.not_encoded: the deposit notice, the title, the long title, the headings and printed notes (not operative); sections 1 and 2 (short title and the Act's own commencement), Schedule 1 clause 2 and the 12 rows of Schedule 2 (machinery); the 21 rows printed as repealed or renumbered
